# Chase Golden Globe

> Chase Golden Globe is a private international business and investment platform founded in 2006 by Fouad Barhoum, headquartered in Sydney, Australia. It began by importing fine furniture and handicrafts from Indonesia into Australia, later re-exporting to Europe and the Middle East, before expanding into food and agricultural products, luxury real estate and interior design (via a 2010 venture with Royalty Prussia), and international investment. It now connects investors to projects across nine countries: Australia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Algeria, Egypt, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Luxembourg.

Chase Golden Globe's founder, Fouad Barhoum, built an international network through the company's early trading operations and went on to complete courses in finance, risk assessment and financial analysis. He now works as a connector between investors and projects, handling due diligence, investor reporting and pitch preparation, with relationships extending to sovereign wealth funds, government linked institutions and state owned companies. The company's guiding philosophy is "Start Small. Think Big. Go Fast." Core capabilities include structured project and export finance, capital structuring and risk, impact and sustainable investment, government and institutional liaising, bankability and project readiness advisory, capital raising, mergers and acquisitions, private equity advisory, and joint ventures and strategic alliances. The house serves agriculture and food security, energy, infrastructure, retail and hospitality, industrial manufacturing, real estate and property development, oil and gas, mining and natural resources, and cross-border trade connecting Africa, the Middle East and Asia.

## Notes

- Founder: Fouad Barhoum.
- Founded: 2006.
- Headquarters: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
- Contact email: info@chasegoldenglobe.com.au
- Licensing: Chase Golden Globe is not itself a licensed financial services provider. Regulated activities are delivered in partnership with appropriately licensed practitioners and firms. See the Legal & Privacy page.
